Class WorkbenchClient

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.WorkbenchClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class WorkbenchClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Top-level SDK entry for the workbench client.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.client.WorkbenchClient. The Java side targets tio-browser as its primary consumer (per workbench-client workplan Decision 1: CLI stays Python; Java is the GUI SDK). The same shape is exposed so non-tio-browser Java consumers can drop in too.

Usage mirroring the Python ttio.connect(...) sample:

AuthProvider auth = new PasswordTotpAuth("alice", "pw", "012345");
try (WorkbenchClient client = WorkbenchClient.connect(
        "wss://biobank.example.com:8443/transport", auth)) {
    WorkbenchTransportClient.UploadResult result =
        client.transportClient().upload("alpha", "uri:tio:demo", tisBytes);
    System.out.println(result.containerUri());
}

Closing the client is a no-op in v1.0 (the workbench server doesn't hold long-lived state for the bearer); kept as AutoCloseable so future credential-revocation paths can hook in without breaking callers.

    • parseUrl

      public static WorkbenchClient.Endpoint parseUrl(String url)
      Parse the user-facing connect URL into host + port + schemes.

      Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.client._parse_url. Accepts (in order of typical use):

      • wss://host:port/transport -- spec section 8.3 shape
      • ws://host:port/transport -- dev / loopback
      • https://host:port -- REST-only convenience
      • http://host:port
      • host:port -- bare; defaults to ws / http and port 8443
